# Milk-tea profile

Use this profile for a milk-tea shop with only the services and products confirmed in the brief.

## Preferred real footage

- Mixing drinks, toppings, sealing cups, snacks, order assembly, delivery handoff, and the actual shop space.
- Local relevance may use a confirmed commune/area, real opening context, or a verified customer situation.
- Distinguish order cutoff, delivery time, opening hours, and dine-in hours; they are not interchangeable.

## Hard boundaries

- Do not invent free delivery, combos, menu items, best sellers, prices, opening hours, seating, or delivery coverage.
- Dine-in, delivery, and promotions may appear only when their corresponding brief fields are present.
- Do not use AI to impersonate the real drinks, shop, staff, or customers.
- Every commercial statement and CTA must resolve to a supplied `brief_path`; otherwise request input or remove it.
